enemies.name: Dublinn Sniffer Hound
enemies.flavour_text: An organism controlled by the Dublinn forces. They were originally purchased from a mercenary group. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

enemies.name: Dublinn Sniffer Hound Pro
enemies.flavour_text: An organism controlled by the Dublinn forces, they are stronger in combat than the average Hound. They were originally purchased from a mercenary group, and have undergone training for a longer period. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

enemies.name: Dublinn Scout
enemies.flavour_text: A scout for the Dublinn forces. With superb concealment techniques, they are the cornerstone of the Dublinn forces' guerilla maneuvers. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

enemies.name: Dublinn Scout Leader
enemies.flavour_text: A scout leader in the Dublinn forces. The scouts under their command are the cornerstone of the Dublinn forces' guerilla maneuvers. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

enemies.name: Dublinn Sniper
enemies.flavour_text: A sniper in the Dublinn forces. The crossbows they wield bear the signs of Columbian modification. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

enemies.name: Dublinn Sniper Leader
enemies.flavour_text: A sniper leader in the Dublinn forces. The crossbows they wield bear the signs of Columbian modification and have much greater penetration power. Equipped with a refractive mask crafted by Shadowcasters, they are rather resistant to regular Originium Arts.

enemies.name: Dublinn Shadowcaster
enemies.flavour_text: A caster in the Dublinn forces. Their Originium Arts do not stand out, but their innovative breakthrough in mass-producing Arts-resistant masks has placed them in good standing amongst the Dublinn forces.

enemies.name: Dublinn Shadowcaster Leader
enemies.flavour_text: A caster leader in the Dublinn forces. Their Originium Arts do not stand out, but the innovative breakthrough of the casters under their command in mass-producing Arts-resistant masks has granted them considerable recognition from their leader.

enemies.name: Dublinn Phalanx Infantry
enemies.flavour_text: A phalanx infantry in the Dublinn forces. The phalanx tactics they utilize evolved from the combat formations used in Gaul. In the phalanx, nearby infantry will support one another, increasing the might of the formation.

abilities.text: When other Phalanx Infantry are nearby, DEF increases (stacks)

enemies.name: Dublinn Phalanx Commander
enemies.flavour_text: A phalanx commander in the Dublinn forces, they organize the infantry under their command into phalanx formations. The phalanx tactics they utilize evolved from the combat formations used in Gaul. In the phalanx, nearby infantry will support one another, increasing the might of the formation.

abilities.text: When other Phalanx Commanders are nearby, DEF increases (stacks)

enemies.name: Dublinn Heavy Defender
enemies.flavour_text: A heavy defender in the Dublinn forces. The armor technology they use comes from Victoria, while their boots were designed in Leithanien. Their shields look extremely similar to a newly patented product from Kazimierz's Roar Guards Company.

enemies.name: Dublinn Heavy Defender Leader
enemies.flavour_text: A heavy defender leader in the Dublinn forces, they wield much more sophisticated equipment. The armor technology they use comes from Victoria, while their boots were designed in Leithanien. Their shields look extremely similar to a newly patented product from Kazimierz's Roar Guards Company.

enemies.name: Dublinn Flying Soldier
enemies.flavour_text: A flying soldier in the Dublinn forces. The steam propulsion device they use originates from a secret laboratory owned by the Victorian military. As it has only recently been deployed in battle, its power output is still unstable.

enemies.name: Dublinn Flying Squad Leader
enemies.flavour_text: A flying squad leader in the Dublinn forces. The steam propulsion device they use originates from a secret laboratory owned by the Victorian military and has gone through many iterations. Its power output is relatively stable.

enemies.name: Tombkeeper Grotesque
enemies.flavour_text: A special Arts creation from the Dublinn forces, created by their leader Mandragora. According to Mandragora, back when she was studying Originium Arts in an outskirts cemetery, the Tombkeeper Grotesque was her first companion. Its outer appearance has gone through many redesigns, with the latest being based off a Sarkaz from an ancient bloodline.

abilities.text: After first defeat, temporarily transforms into a stone statue with extremely high DEF, then revives as an aerial unit

enemies.name: Enraged Tombkeeper Grotesque
enemies.flavour_text: A special Arts creation from the Dublinn forces, created by their leader Mandragora. According to Mandragora, back when she was studying Originium Arts in an outskirts cemetery, the Tombkeeper Grotesque was her first companion. Its outer appearance has gone through many redesigns, with the latest being based off a Sarkaz from an ancient bloodline. This series of Tombkeepers embodies Mandragora's fury towards Victoria.

abilities.text: After first defeat, temporarily transforms into a stone statue with extremely high DEF, then revives as an aerial unit

enemies.name: Dublinn Flamerazer
enemies.flavour_text: A special squad that uses flamethrowers in the Dublinn forces. Their leader's teachings reverberate in their minds as they seek to reforge Terra amidst the endless flames.

abilities.text: Continuously deals Arts damage and Burn for the skill duration
Upon death, explodes and deals Arts damage, knocking down nearby Tattered Pillars and instantly defeating other <Dublinn Flamerazers>

enemies.name: Dublinn Flamerazer Leader
enemies.flavour_text: A leader of a special squad that uses flamethrowers in the Dublinn forces. Their leader's teachings reverberate in their minds as they seek to reforge Terra amidst the endless flames.

abilities.text: Continuously deals Arts damage and Burn for the skill duration
Upon death, explodes and deals Arts damage, knocking down nearby Tattered Pillars and instantly defeating other <Dublinn Flamerazers>

enemies.name: Dublinn Companion Guard
enemies.flavour_text: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad. The structure of this squad mimics the military system of ancient Minos. The shields they wield are the culmination of many nations' technologies, providing cover for their partners while advancing, and protecting all nearby allies from harm.

abilities.text: More likely to get attacked by your units
When a <Dublinn Companion Shadowblade> is nearby, activates a field that reduces nearby allied units' ASPD

enemies.name: Dublinn Elite Companion Guard
enemies.flavour_text: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad, they are much stronger than regular squad members. The shields they wield are the culmination of many nations' technologies, providing cover for their partners while advancing, and protecting all nearby allies from harm.

abilities.text: More likely to get attacked by your units
When a <Dublinn Elite Companion Shadowblade> is nearby, activates a field that reduces nearby allied units' ASPD

enemies.name: Dublinn Companion Shadowblade
enemies.flavour_text: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad. The structure of this squad mimics the military system of ancient Minos. When they move alongside their partners, they gain powerful stealth capabilities and their attacks are much swifter.

abilities.text: When a <Dublinn Companion Guard> is nearby, significantly increases ASPD

enemies.name: Dublinn Elite Companion Shadowblade
enemies.flavour_text: A member of the Dublinn forces' elite operations squad, they are much stronger than regular squad members. When they move alongside their partners, they gain powerful stealth capabilities and their attacks are much swifter.

abilities.text: When a <Dublinn Elite Companion Guard> is nearby, significantly increases ASPD

enemies.name: Dublinn Evocator
enemies.flavour_text: An evocation caster in the Dublinn forces who can control fireballs. Their leader's teachings reverberate in their minds as they work to purify the corruption of Terra in raging flames.

abilities.text: Controls <Purifying Flames> that move along the ground and explode after hitting a melee ally unit, dealing Arts damage and Burn; damage dealt decreases with distance moved

enemies.name: Dublinn Evocator Leader
enemies.flavour_text: An evocation caster leader in the Dublinn forces who can control fireballs, they are more adept at using Originium Arts than their underlings. Their leader's teachings reverberate in their minds as they work to purify the corruption of Terra in raging flames.

abilities.text: Controls <Purifying Flames> that move along the ground and explode after hitting a melee ally unit, dealing Arts damage and Burn; damage dealt decreases with distance moved

enemies.name: Mandragora
enemies.flavour_text: One of the leaders of the Dublinn forces, a caster who controls stone. Emerging from the darkness of Victoria, she has sworn to repay the humiliation she suffered at the hands of the nobles manyfold.

abilities.text: [Stoneshield] Reduces damage taken; temporarily loses effect after being hit by a Tattered Pillar
[Mandragora's Gaze] Targets the unit with the highest ATK within range, dealing Arts damage and reducing their ASPD. If the target is retreated or defeated, destroy the tile the unit is on
[Stoneshield] Grants Low-Altitude Hovering, and continuously deals Arts damage to units within range
